{
  "candidate_rtl": "module mux_large (
    input [7:0] block_a, block_b, block_c, block_d, block_e,
    input [7:0] block_f, block_g, block_h, block_i, block_j,
    input [3:0] sel,
    output reg [7:0] block_out
);
    wire en_a, en_b, en_c, en_d, en_e;
    wire en_f, en_g, en_h, en_i, en_j;

    assign en_a = (~|sel) | (sel[3] & (sel[2] | sel[1]));
    assign en_b = (sel == 4'b0001);
    assign en_c = (sel == 4'b0010);
    assign en_d = (sel == 4'b0011);
    assign en_e = (sel == 4'b0100);
    assign en_f = (sel == 4'b0101);
    assign en_g = (sel == 4'b0110);
    assign en_h = (sel == 4'b0111);
    assign en_i = (sel == 4'b1000);
    assign en_j = (sel == 4'b1001);

    always @(*) begin
        block_out = ({8{en_a}} & block_a)
                  | ({8{en_b}} & block_b)
                  | ({8{en_c}} & block_c)
                  | ({8{en_d}} & block_d)
                  | ({8{en_e}} & block_e)
                  | ({8{en_f}} & block_f)
                  | ({8{en_g}} & block_g)
                  | ({8{en_h}} & block_h)
                  | ({8{en_i}} & block_i)
                  | ({8{en_j}} & block_j);
    end
endmodule
",
  "bottleneck": "The baseline critical path runs from the select decoder through buffering and several output-combination stages. Default-case handling participates in this select-to-output cone.",
  "rewrite": "Replace the case statement with explicit mutually exclusive enables and a parallel masked-data OR network. The block_a enable directly covers selection 0 and default selections 10 through 15, avoiding a default enable constructed by negating the union of the other nine selections.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "The explicit parallel network targets fewer select-to-output logic stages and simpler default decoding. A modest improvement over the 1.04 ns baseline is plausible, but no mapped timing result is available and a gain is not guaranteed.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "The design uses ten shared enable signals and eight parallel data-combination cones. Decoder fanout may require buffering. Area, the 1006.089920 um^2 cap, and zero electrical violations must be checked with the specified mapping and STA flow; they have not been measured here.",
  "functional_boundaries": "For every two-state input, selections 0 through 9 return block_a through block_j respectively, and selections 10 through 15 return block_a. Exactly one enable is asserted for each selection. The module name, ports, unsigned widths, combinational behavior, and absence of parameters are preserved. No storage, latency, assumptions, or external dependencies are introduced. Mapped equivalence remains to be verified."
